brief:
Israel's Supreme Court has ordered Palestinian politician Sami Abu Shehadeh to withdraw from the upcoming election or face disqualification, Al Jazeera English reported. The ruling marks what observers describe as a "new threshold" in the suppression of Palestinian political participation.

Abu Shehadeh, a member of the Palestinian Legislative Council, now faces a choice between abandoning his candidacy or being barred from running. The court's intervention in Palestinian electoral processes represents an escalation in restrictions on Palestinian political activity.
dek: Israel’s top court told Palestinian politician Sami Abu Shehadeh to withdraw from the election or face disqualification.
title: Israel's top court orders Palestinian politician off ballot
